move: stick-figure limbs morph through a four-pose run cycle with body bob
how: A black blob-bodied runner on orange: four limb paths (front/back leg and arm) morphSVG through four stride poses, one per quarter of D with power1.inOut, the back limbs offset by two poses and arms counter to legs. The body group bobs y 384 to 358 twice per stride (sine.inOut yoyo), the lean group rocks 10 to 14 degrees, the shadow ellipse scales 1 to 0.8, the head lags by 0.04s, and three speed lines stream left 300px twice per loop (ease none).
adapt: Change body and background colours, the tag string, and the pose point arrays for a different gait; keep one stride per D and the half-stride offset of the back limbs.
port: mount(el, shot) injects the SVG; animate(el, shot, D) returns the timeline with STEP = D/4. Scope '#legF' etc. via el.querySelector and call gsap.set on initial pose d attrs in mount.
caveats: speed lines tween x 0 to -300 with repeat 1 and no yoyo, so at t=D they sit at -300 while at t=0 they sit at 0; the loop is seamless for the runner but the lines jump
D=1 is very short; the catalog says 1s
